description: This file defines the UtilTimer class, a utility for tracking and reporting elapsed time during process execution within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for starting timers, generating timing strings, logging, and managing static timers. The class is used for performance measurement and logging purposes within the project.

classes.name: UtilTimer
classes.description: A utility class for timing operations, providing methods to start timers, generate timing reports, and manage static timer instances.

methods.name: makeTimer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new UtilTimer instance.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Initializes the timer and records the start time.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently running.

methods.name: timerString
methods.description: Generates a timing report string with a message.

methods.name: timerString
methods.description: Overloaded; generates a timing report string with message and class name.

methods.name: secondsSinceStart
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds elapsed since the timer started.

methods.name: secondsSinceLast
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last call to timerString.

methods.name: timeSinceLast
methods.description: Returns milliseconds since the last timerString call.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Enables or disables logging for the timer.

methods.name: timerString
methods.description: Generates a formatted, indented timing string with level, message.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves an existing static timer or creates a new one by name.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a named timer with logging option.

methods.name: timerLog
methods.description: Logs a message with the timer, starting it if necessary.

methods.name: closeTimer
methods.description: Removes a timer by name, optionally logging a message.
